button.name: button_mark_done
button.confirm: There are no components to consume. Are you still sure you want to continue?

button.name: button_plan
button.invisible: state not in ('confirmed', 'progress', 'to_close') or not workorder_ids or is_planned

button.name: action_cancel
button.confirm: Are you sure you want to cancel this manufacturing order?

button.name: action_generate_bom
button.title: Generate a new BoM from this Manufacturing Order

button.name: action_update_bom
button.title: Note that another version of this BOM is available.
button.invisible: not is_outdated_bom or state not in ['draft', 'confirmed']

label.invisible: state in ('draft', 'cancel') or product_tracking in ('none', False) or (state == 'done' and product_tracking == 'serial' and product_qty > 1)

div.invisible: state in ('draft', 'cancel') or product_tracking in ('none', False) or (state == 'done' and product_tracking == 'serial' and product_qty > 1)

field.name: lot_producing_ids
field.invisible: product_tracking in ('none', False) or (product_tracking == 'serial' and (product_qty > 1 or serial_numbers_count > 1))

button.name: action_generate_serial
button.title: Creates a new serial number
button.invisible: product_tracking in ('none', 'lot', False) or not lot_producing_ids or product_qty == 1

button.name: action_clear_lot_producing_ids
button.title: Clears the selected lot/serial number
button.invisible: state == 'done' or (product_tracking == 'serial' and product_qty > 1) or not lot_producing_ids

field.name: date_start
field.help: Date at which you plan to start. Red if the scheduled end is forecasted after the production order deadline. Orange if the scheduled date is in the past.
field.decoration-danger: state not in ('done', 'cancel') and date_deadline and date_deadline < date_end
field.decoration-warning: state not in ('done', 'cancel') and date_start < now

field.name: move_raw_ids
field.context: {'default_date': date_start, 'default_date_deadline': date_start, 'default_location_id': location_src_id, 'default_location_dest_id': production_location_id, 'default_warehouse_id': warehouse_id, 'default_state': 'draft', 'default_raw_material_production_id': id, 'default_picking_type_id': picking_type_id, 'default_company_id': company_id, 'form_view_ref': 'mrp.view_mrp_stock_move_operations', 'active_mo_id': id}

field.name: product_id
field.readonly: move_lines_count > 0 or state == 'cancel' or (state != 'draft' and not additional)

field.name: product_uom_qty
field.readonly: parent.state != 'draft' and ((parent.state not in ('confirmed', 'progress', 'to_close') and not parent.is_planned) or (parent.is_locked and state != 'draft'))

field.name: product_uom_qty
field.readonly: parent.state != 'draft' and ((parent.state not in ('confirmed', 'progress', 'to_close') and not parent.is_planned) or (parent.is_locked and state != 'draft'))

field.name: quantity
field.decoration-success: (state not in ['done', 'cancel']) and (quantity - (should_consume_qty if parent.qty_producing else product_uom_qty) == 0)
field.decoration-warning: (state not in ['done', 'cancel']) and (quantity - (should_consume_qty if parent.qty_producing else product_uom_qty) > 0.0001)

field.name: move_byproduct_ids
field.context: {'default_date': date_end, 'default_date_deadline': date_deadline, 'default_warehouse_id': warehouse_id, 'default_location_id': production_location_id, 'default_location_dest_id': location_dest_id, 'default_state': 'draft', 'default_production_id': id, 'default_picking_type_id': picking_type_id, 'default_company_id': company_id, 'form_view_ref': 'mrp.view_mrp_stock_move_operations'}

field.name: product_id
field.readonly: move_lines_count > 0 or state == 'cancel' or (state != 'draft' and not additional)

field.name: product_uom_qty
field.readonly: parent.state != 'draft' and ((parent.state not in ('confirmed', 'progress', 'to_close') and not parent.is_planned) or parent.is_locked)
